permits.description: drywall storage room walls and ceiing with 5/8" type x, and clad walls w/ sheet metal. install a new 60 min. fire-rated door assembly to tradesman passageway. install ventilation fan in storage room with make up air from exterior. storage room is in rear left corner of left hand garage.
kitchen remodel in kind. approx. 90 sq ft.remove and install new cabinets & flooring. remove drywall for electrical and reinstall.
upgrade existing fire alarm system to comply wih sffc section 1103.7.6.1.

to comply w/ nov# 202302572, seismic retrofit of (e) building that has a garage level with brick perimeter walls and steel framing and 3-stories of wood frame above. to comply with chapter sfebc 5b and 5c - earthquake hazard reduction and seismic strengthening provisions for umb wall buildings
soft story mandate compliance, garage level target story seismic upgrade per cebc 2022, in order to preserve parking areas

one unit (2nd fl): renovation. new bedroom. new kitchen cabinets & plumbing fixtures. new washer/dryer & dishwasher. new lighting at (e) j-boxes. no change to mechanical. no exterior work. no fire alarm or no sprinkler work.

renovation of (1) apartment: one unit on 3rd fl & one unit on 4th fl. new office at #202; new bedrooms. new kitchen cabinets and plumbing fixtures. new washer/dryer & dishwasher. new lighting at (e) j-boxes. no change to mechanical. no exterior work, no fire alarm or no sprinkler work.
like for like replacement + 2023 mandate installation of fire alarm system in non sprinkered building to satisfy sffc 1103.7.6.1

per adu ord# 162-16, add 3 units on 1st level. convert (e) garage into new units within (e) envelope. new bedrooms, bathrooms, dishwashers, washer/dryers, windows visible from street. sprinkler per nfpa 13 & fire alarm per nfpa 72 under separate permit. seismic retrofit under pa# 202311291610.

two units: new bedroooms and bathrooms. new kitchen cabinets & plumbing fixtures. new washer/dryers & dishwashers. new lighting at (e) j-boxes. no change to mechanical. no exterior work/fire alarm/sprinkler work.

one unit, 4th fl - reno bedroom and bathroom. new kitchen cabinets and plumbing fixtures. new washer/dryer & dishwasher. new lighting at (e) j-box locations. no change to mechanical, no exterior work, fire alarm or sprinkler work. structural work needed
soft story retrofit per chapter 4d revision to 201809170520
remove roofing membrane and replace dryrot damaged framing in kind. install new roofing membrane.
remove bay roof 8" of stucco of building at top of bay. install new waterproof membrane and modified bitumen cap sheet. restucco disturbed areas with flat plinth block.

permit_summary.note: 4 nominal $1 street-space or sidewalk permits are omitted from the timeline.
